root.text: A hollow-cheeked boy in oversized rags huddles beneath the gibbet platform, shivering uncontrollably. He clutches an iron key ring and a leather-bound book against his ribs, terrified of the zealot guards. 'P-please... don't let them burn me mister! I didn't steal nothing, I swear!'

choices.text: Kneel down, speaking softly. 'I won't hurt you, lad. You are safe with me.'
[Guile 11] 'Keep low in the ditch, Toby. If a guard turns his torch, stay still like a stone. Watch my footing.'
[Sinew 12] 'Hand over that key and book right now, or I'll throw you to the Dawnbound.'

toby_taught.text: Toby's wide eyes soak in your movements. He mimics your crouching stride beneath the shadows of the scaffold. 'You move like a ghost, mister! I will remember how to slip past the pyre guards.'

choices.text: 'Good lad. Now let's see to your safety.'

toby_comforted.text: Toby's trembling slows, tears spilling down his soot-stained face. 'Nobody spoke kindly to me since yesterday... You're a good man, mister. Take this—it's the Master Sluice Key! The turnkey dropped it when the sickness took him. It opens the iron gate in the Trench. And here's his book with all the city secrets!' He hands you both items.

choices.text: Ruffle his hair gently. 'Hide in the hollow barrels until nightfall, Toby. Stay quiet and stay alive.'
'Go to the Gilded Rat parlour. Tell Madame Silve I sent you to hide in her dry cellar.'

toby_safehouse.text: 'The fancy lady's place? With real blankets?!' Toby hugs your leg with tears streaming down his grimy face. 'Thank you, mister! Toby won't ever forget you!' He scurries like a mouse into the alley toward the Gilded Rat.

toby_saved.text: 'Thank you, mister! Toby won't forget this!' The boy scrambles into the shadows of the drainage culvert.

toby_robbed.text: Toby screams in terror, dropping the key and book in the mud before fleeing like a frightened rabbit into the dark. You picked up the Master Sluice Key and Turnkey Ledger, but the pariahs watching from the alleys curse your name.
